releases.title: The six-chapter Campaign
notes: Campaign: six chapters from Return to Sender to Address Filed, kept in three case-file save slots.
Each chapter is its own place: the wall, the Clearing Floor, the Process Servers, the archive shelves.
Explore, talk, pick things up, then fight. Progress stays filed.

releases.title: Arcade: three acts in the Hollow
notes: Arcade: hold the circle against the Clearing Crew in three acts of waves.
Arcade scores and Campaign saves are kept apart.

releases.title: Boss set pieces
notes: Bosses arrive at waves 10, 20 and 30 in Arcade, each with an entrance.
The Courier opens Chapter 1 with a notice of striking. The Registrar reads the ledger in Chapter 5.

releases.title: Small behind-the-scenes updates
notes: Improvements and fixes.

releases.title: Wallit talks, Slice guards, new menus
notes: Wallit now has a moving mouth and his own voice.
Slice now stands guard around the circle instead of sitting still, and she has more personality of her own.
Characters stop on a dime now instead of sliding across the ground.
Each run now has a clearer point to its story.
The main menu has been reworked again, with a more polished look and feel.

releases.title: Wallit and friends get new looks
notes: Wallit now takes the field as a 3D character with his own bat and a full set of moves.
Slice appears in 3D, with her knife and new stabbing animations.
Yo Bot and Spider Bot now appear as 3D enemies with animations.
The Spider Bot description now matches its six legs.
Pressing a number key to pick a level-up card no longer stalls the run.

releases.title: Pickups work again in the browser version
notes: Pickups should now work properly in the browser version of the game.

releases.title: Slice, Wallit and the bots go 3D
notes: Slice now has a 3D model, with a knife and a stabbing animation.
Wallit now appears in 3D and has his full set of moves.
Yo Bot and Spider Bot are now 3D, with animated movement.
Some crashes that could interrupt a run are gone.

releases.title: Improvements and fixes
notes: Improvements and fixes.

releases.title: Behind the scenes
notes: Improvements and fixes.

releases.title: The Place has an address
notes: The Moonlit Hollow opens. Wallit and a bat hold the circle against the Clearing Crew.
He grows every wave. Feathers level him up, and every level is a choice of boons.
When the circle falls, the run is over. Coins from it buy upgrades for the next one.
Tap to play turns the sound on. Settings keep it where you put it.
